gmcm.cats-scare-crows.name: Cats Scare Crows
gmcm.cats-scare-crows.tooltip: While a cat lives on your farm, crows never eat your crops, even without scarecrows.
gmcm.dogs-herd.name: Dogs Herd Animals
gmcm.dogs-herd.tooltip: While a dog lives on your farm, it opens the barn and coop doors in the morning and lets the animals out, then herds them back in at night and closes the doors. Host only.
gmcm.herd-out-time.name: Let Animals Out At
gmcm.herd-out-time.tooltip: When the dog opens the doors and lets the animals out. Doors stay shut on rainy days, in winter and on festival days.
gmcm.herd-in-time.name: Herd Animals In At
gmcm.herd-in-time.tooltip: When the dog starts calling the animals back to their buildings.
gmcm.close-doors-time.name: Close Doors At
gmcm.close-doors-time.tooltip: When the dog brings any stragglers inside and closes the doors.
gmcm.turtles-roe.name: Turtles Boost Roe
gmcm.turtles-roe.tooltip: While a turtle lives on your farm, fish ponds produce more roe.
gmcm.roe-multiplier.name: Roe Multiplier
gmcm.roe-multiplier.tooltip: How much extra roe ponds produce. Fractions are rounded up or down at random, so 1.5 gives 1 or 2 roe from a single roe. Default: 1.5.
doc.overview.title: What This Mod Does
doc.overview.intro: Every kind of pet now earns its keep on the farm. The perk is active as long as at least one pet of that kind lives on your farm.
doc.overview.cat-value: Scares away crows, so you don't need scarecrows
doc.overview.dog-value: Lets the animals out in the morning and herds them in at night, opening and closing the doors
doc.cats.title: Cats Scare Crows
doc.cats.intro: With a cat on the farm, crows stay away overnight and never eat your crops. Scarecrows still work as usual, but you no longer need them to protect your fields.
doc.cats.note: Any cat counts, wherever it happens to be sleeping. You do not need to pet it.
doc.dogs.title: Dogs Herd Your Animals
doc.dogs.intro: With a dog on the farm, your barn and coop doors take care of themselves.
doc.dogs.morning-body: At 6:10 AM the dog opens the door of every barn and coop and your animals trickle out onto the farm to graze.
doc.dogs.evening-body: At 6:00 PM the dog calls the animals back. They walk to their doors and go inside. By 7:00 PM any stragglers are brought in and the doors are closed.
doc.dogs.exceptions-body: On rainy days, in winter and on festival days the animals stay inside, just like in vanilla. The doors are still closed for you at night.
doc.dogs.multiplayer: In multiplayer only the host herds the animals.
doc.turtles.title: Turtles Boost Roe
doc.turtles.intro: With a turtle on the farm, every roe your fish ponds produce is multiplied by 1.5.
doc.turtles.rounding-label: How does a multiplier of 1.5 work on a single roe?
doc.turtles.rounding-text: The result is rounded up or down at random so the average matches the multiplier. A single roe becomes 1 or 2 roe, and over many days you get 50% more.
doc.config.title: Configuration
doc.config.intro: Edit config.json or use Generic Mod Config Menu. Every perk can be switched off on its own.
doc.config.cats: Turns the cat perk on or off.
doc.config.dogs: Turns the dog perk on or off.
doc.config.turtles: Turns the turtle perk on or off.
doc.config.roe-multiplier: How many times more roe ponds produce while a turtle lives on the farm.
doc.config.herd-out: When the dog lets the animals out. Times use the 24 hour format, so 610 is 6:10 AM.
doc.config.herd-in: When the dog starts calling the animals back in.
doc.config.close-doors: When the dog brings stragglers inside and closes the doors.
